# Vorley Analytics

Vorley Analytics is a specialized technology company delivering SafeSite AI, an advanced safety monitoring device designed for construction sites. SafeSite AI leverages computer vision and machine learning to identify hazards in real time, alerting site supervisors before incidents occur. Its primary users are infrastructure development firms managing large-scale projects such as bridges, roads, and urban transit systems.

Since launching pilot programs in early 2023, Vorley Analytics has partnered with three major infrastructure contractors across North Arcadia and Central Westland. These pilots demonstrated a 30% reduction in incident reports, validating the product’s effectiveness. The company recently closed a $7 million Series A round led by Ridgeview Ventures to expand deployments and enhance AI capabilities.

Vorley’s core team includes CEO Dana Rellins (previously a construction engineer), CTO Marco Sun (ex-robotics startup lead), and Head of Data Science Embley Mehta. They face direct competition from BuildGuard Solutions and SiteSense AI, both focusing on construction safety analytics.

Open risks include scaling device hardware production, ensuring data privacy compliance, and achieving broader industry adoption amid conservative safety cultures.
